title: Sweet tea miss Kennedy having poured with milk plugged both two ears with little fingers
html_source: A Homeric allusion – the crews ears are full of wax and Ulysses is lashed to the mast as they approach the Sirens.

 Miss Kennedy, pouring now fulldrawn tea, grimaced and prayed: 

1932#232

 — O, don't remind me of him for mercy'sake! 

 — But wait till I tell you, Miss Douce entreated.
anchor.suffix:
. 

 — No, don't, she cried. 

1939#189

 — I won't listen, she cried. 

 But Bloom? 

 Miss Douce grunted in snuffy fogey's tone: 

 — For your what? says he. 

 Miss Kennedy unpl
